messages:
ava_cs: Heads-up — MeridianAnalytics asked to accelerate their renewal and change invoicing to monthly. Asking for a 10% term discount if we sign this week. Current ARR $310k, 12mo. Procurement wants PO + DPA. Need legal + finance + enablement before sending DocuSign.

mike_sales: I spoke with their procurement lead. They can do PO but only if we accept monthly invoices and include the DPA. Buyer pushing for 10% and a 1-month onboarding credit.

tara_legal: I'll draft the contract redline and attach the DPA. If we give 10% we should cap additional concessions and add a pricing guardrail. Also want to verify indemnity and data residency text. ETA 4pm PT.

leo_fin: Finance prefers Net30 but monthly invoicing is ok with PO referencing vendor code MA-221. If discount >=10% this needs VP Finance approval. Also confirm whether onboarding credit is revenue deferral.

sam_enable: Enablement can provide a 60-min kickoff within 5 business days. Need list of 3 technical contacts + preferred times. We'll include a 3-question feedback pulse after week 2.

nina_se: SE notes: recent token-rate spikes on gen endpoints. Recommend we include perf checklist and a short remediation playbook to avoid first-week churn. I'll add sample configs.

ava_cs: Action items: @tara_legal redline + DPA; @leo_fin confirm vendor code and approval path; @mike_sales confirm discount authority; @sam_enable prep invite template; @nina_se add perf notes.

tara_legal: Uploaded draft redline: https://drive.company/contracts/meridian_redline_v1. Added clause: "one-month onboarding credit applied to first invoice; pricing guardrail: any additional concessions require VP Sales sign-off." PTAL.

mike_sales: Quick update from buyer: CFO ok with 9% not 10%. Can we do 9%?

tara_legal: 9% ok. I'll update the redline and keep DPA attached.

leo_fin: Vendor code MA-221 confirmed. VP Finance notified for discount approval. If they approve, we'll accept monthly PO with Net30 payment terms signaled on the SOW.

notify_bot: VP Finance approval recorded: approved at 6077777790 for 9% discount.

mike_sales: Great — preparing final commercial summary. I'll send DocuSign once Tara posts final SOW.

tara_legal: Final redline posted: https://drive.company/contracts/meridian_redline_final. Includes DPA, 9% discount, onboarding credit, pricing guardrail.

mike_sales: Sending DocuSign now -> https://docusign.company/meridian_abc (signers: CFO, procurement ops). Including vendor code MA-221. Adding @ava_cs as cc.

ava_cs: Logged renewal in Gainsight and set "early_renewal" flag. Monitoring signature; will escalate if not signed in 4 business days.

notify_bot: DocuSign envelope status: completed at 6077777801. PO MA-221 received and matched. Invoice terms: monthly, Net30.

sam_enable: Onboarding scheduled Apr 20 09:00 PT (60min). Invite + 3-question survey will go out after session.

nina_se: Perf checklist and runbook snippet uploaded to the onboarding pack. Will join kickoff.

ava_cs: Closing loop: contract signed, PO in, onboarding scheduled. Will post survey results after enablement. Thanks team :tada:"
